scope: Proposition 4.2 (Marked matching laws) of the manuscript “A Fully Polynomial Randomized Approximation Scheme for Perfect Matchings in General Graphs” (preprints/A-Fully-Polynomial-Randomized-Approximation-Scheme-for-Perfect-Matchings-in-General-Graphs-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 113 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1510b15725ee7e92), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For arbitrary positive logical activities, sample from the bag matching law and reveal the edge portions as above. The all-real event has probability 1/I; conditional on this event, the decoded logical matching has law πλ. For each logical edge uv, P(probe for uv is used and all other edges are real) = gλ(uv) DI . (4.4) Conditional on this event, the residual logical matching has the λ-weighted perfect-matching law on the vertices other than u, v.
